pool.text: Explorer settled region, sparking a gold‑rush expedition.
Brazil became a republic, prompting a new state capital plan.
Curral Del Rey chosen as site for new capital.
Cidade de Minas inaugurated with many unfinished buildings.
City renamed Belo Horizonte, meaning "Beautiful Horizon".
Obelisk erected in Sete de Setembro Square.
American film praised the city's planning and construction.
Palácio das Artes reopened as the Art Museum.
Puppet theatre group Giramundo founded in the city.
Palácio das Artes opened, designed by Oscar Niemeyer.
Confins International Airport opened 38 km from the city.
Mayor launched right‑to‑food policies and farmers’ markets.
Serra do Rola‑Moça State Park established covering 3,941 ha.
Palácio das Artes added multimedia rooms, library and café bar.
Annual Comida di Buteco festival began across city bars.
Partnership with Fort Lauderdale led to Parque Fort Lauderdale creation.
Pampulha Ecological Park inaugurated on May 21.
Inter‑American Development Bank meeting convened in the city.
Former mayor nominated for World Mayor prize.
Many flights shifted from Pampulha to Confins airport.
